vertebrae.results
=================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.results

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Structured benchmark results.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.results.ExtractorResult
   vertebrae.results.BenchmarkResult


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: ExtractorResult

   Result data for one evaluated extractor.

   .. attribute:: name

      Extractor name.

   .. attribute:: extractor_type

      Extractor family/type metadata.

   .. attribute:: overlap

      OverlapIndex scoring result.

   .. attribute:: stability

      Optional stability-analysis summary.

   .. attribute:: probes

      Optional probe-classifier summary.

   .. attribute:: embedding_metadata

      Metadata for the embedding artifact.

   .. attribute:: runtime

      Runtime timing metadata by benchmark stage.

   .. attribute:: warnings

      Warnings produced during evaluation.

   .. attribute:: recommendation

      Recommendation label for this extractor.

   .. attribute:: weakest_class

      Class with the lowest per-class score when available.

   .. attribute:: weakest_class_score

      Score for `weakest_class` when available.


   .. py:method:: to_dict()

      Serialize the extractor result to a JSON-safe dictionary.

      :returns: JSON-compatible result data.



.. py:class:: BenchmarkResult

   Aggregated result for a benchmark run.

   .. attribute:: dataset_summary

      Summary of the labeled dataset.

   .. attribute:: extractor_results

      Per-extractor results.

   .. attribute:: recommendations

      Practitioner-facing benchmark recommendations.

   .. attribute:: metadata

      Reproducibility metadata for the run.


   .. py:method:: to_dict()

      Serialize the benchmark result to a JSON-safe dictionary.

      :returns: JSON-compatible benchmark data.



   .. py:method:: ranked_results()

      Return extractor results sorted by descending macro score.

      :returns: Sorted extractor results.



   .. py:method:: to_dataframe()

      Convert benchmark rankings into a pandas DataFrame.

      :returns: A pandas DataFrame with one row per extractor.



   .. py:method:: save_json(path)

      Save the benchmark result as JSON.

      :param path: Destination file path.



   .. py:method:: save_markdown(path)

      Save the benchmark result as a Markdown report.

      :param path: Destination file path.
